items.docs:
## Update existing test case.
            
* **fields**: The native Jira fields in a test case. Only the following fields are available (for the rest please use native Jira API):
    * **summary** _(optional)_: The Summary of the test case in Jira. To remove the summary, provide an empty string.
    * **description** _(optional)_: The Description of the test case in Jira. To remove the description, provide an empty string.
    * **priority** _(optional)_: The Priority of the test case in Jira.

params.name: key
params.description: The Jira id or key of the test.

params.name: confirmation
params.description:
Changing a test case from Manual to Automated overwrites your precondition and test steps.
Select True to confirm that you want to delete the precondition and test steps from the test case.

## Add or update automation content and details for a test case.
            
#### Body fields:
            
* **name**: The name of the automation for the test case.
* **externalId** _(optional)_: The external Id of the automated test from the external automation system.
* **key**: The Jira key of the test case .
